audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly warns about 'wall-knockups' but never states the actual combo: Volcanic Rupture (Q) leaves a magma pillar, and that pillar is the terrain Searing Charge (E) collides with. Away from walls and pillars, E is damage only.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit on both halves — Q 'a magma pillar forms at the end location', E 'if Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave... knocks up'. Knowing the pillar is the wall converts 'don't stand near walls' into a rule the player can actually follow mid-lane: watch where the pillar lands, then stand anywhere else.
audit.corrected: Q-pillar-into-E stated in phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warns that Ornn cuts off retreats and Mundo cannot dash out.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture's pillar and Searing Charge both create terrain, and Dr. Mundo has no dash in his kit — Flash is the only answer to being walled off, so it must be saved for that rather than spent to dodge damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volcanic Rupture is listed at 10s; Bellows Breath, Searing Charge and Call of the Forge God carry no numbers at all.
audit.why: Real values: Q 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, W 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, E 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, R 140/120/100. E's 14 seconds is the longest gap in his lane kit and is the window Mundo actually steps into.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: 2+ items is given to Ornn in both layers, while content whys[6] ('neither tank solo-kills the other late, pure skill and macro'), spikes[3] and the packet chart all say Skill. Separately breakdown.spikes and report[2] claim Mundo's windows are 'Level 6, First item, 2+ items' — three rows the chart gives to Ornn.
audit.why: Mundo wins 53.56% here, so the page cannot end with Ornn owning the last stage; and the spikes summary must not name windows the chart hands the enemy.
audit.corrected: 2+ items flipped to Skill in both layers as one chart edit, and the spikes/level-chart summaries rewritten to match the chart they sit above.

edits.before: Warmog's makes you a raid boss: full HP between every fight. Ornn needs Grievous Wounds and a jungler to even slow you down — split, soak, win.
edits.after: Neither tank kills the other now — your regen answers his poke, his resists answer your damage. It is decided by roams and teamfight angles.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Volcanic Rupture is up.
edits.after: His combo is Volcanic Rupture's pillar into Searing Charge — away from walls and that pillar the charge is damage only. Never trade beside terrain.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture (10s): matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Volcanic Rupture (9s at rank 1): the fissure leaves a magma pillar, and that pillar is the wall he charges into. - Searing Charge (14s) only knocks up on terrain, so fight in the open. - Bellows Breath (12s) is what makes you Brittle; wait it out.

edits.before: Track Ornn’s Volcanic Rupture (10s): Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture (9s at rank 1) builds the pillar; Searing Charge (14s) only knocks up if he hits it. Fight in the open.

edits.before: Your windows: Level 6, First item, 2+ items. His windows: Level 1, Level 2. Fight at your spikes, concede his — the level chart above is the trade calendar.
edits.after: His windows: Level 2, Level 3, First item. Yours: none in lane — farm to 2+ items and win it on the map. The chart above is your trade calendar.

edits.before: See the level-by-level chart — fight in your windows (Level 6, First item, 2+ items), respect his (Level 1, Level 2).
edits.after: See the level-by-level chart — your window is 2+ items and the map; respect his (Level 2, Level 3, First item).

edits.before: Burn HP early — that is the exchange Ornn wins flat.
edits.after: Retreat past his pillar — you have no dash for it.

edits.before: Ornn out-trades you with Bellows Breath (W) damage-reduction shield and a Searing Charge (E) knock-up that he can brittle-detonate for a second stun, so every time you dive in on Q he punishes you harder than you hit him.
edits.after: Ornn out-trades you behind Bellows Breath (W), which leaves you Brittle, and Searing Charge (E) — but E only knocks up if he collides with terrain, and his own Volcanic Rupture pillar counts as terrain. Stand clear of walls and it is just damage.

edits.before: Dodge Searing Charge (E) so he can't set up the brittle stun
edits.after: Stand clear of walls so Searing Charge (E) can't knock you up

notes: The packet's suspectNames hit on 'Land Searing Charge' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Searing Charge is the correct name of Ornn's E. DATA DISCREPANCY worth checking: the brief header says games 1844 but the packet inside the same brief says games 900 for this matchup; I used the packet's winRate (53.56) since that is what the chart is measured against. UNVERIFIED and left alone: exactly what detonating Brittle does (the existing text says 'second stun'). Riot's description only states that Bellows Breath applies Brittle and says nothing about the detonation effect, so I neither repeated nor contradicted that claim — I rewrote around it.
